ideas.pitch: A real-time security log analysis dashboard built specifically to detect zero-day web attacks and abnormal traffic spikes in NGINX logs using lightweight local LLMs.
ideas.title: AegisLog: AI-Powered NGINX Log Threat Intelligence and Anomaly Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages direct inspiration from a proven hackathon winner (github:985196561) in the Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking track, offering high visual impact and immediate utility for system administrators.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered anti-money laundering platform that combines graph intelligence networks with explainable machine learning models to trace suspicious financial transactions.
ideas.title: GraphGuard: AML Risk Detection and Investigation Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the architecture of a first-place fintech hackathon winner (github:1181344931), combining complex graph visualization with explainable AI which appeals strongly to judges looking for enterprise-grade depth.

ideas.pitch: A solo-friendly developer toolkit that scans uploaded machine learning datasets and trained models to detect demographic bias and automatically apply mitigation techniques.
ideas.title: FairAudit: Automated Bias Detection and Mitigation for ML Models
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of a solo-built project (github:1266090747) targeting AI ethics and fairness, a rapidly growing evaluation priority for technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated system that processes multi-temporal satellite imagery using computer vision to detect unauthorized industrial expansion and land-use violations.
ideas.title: GeoCompliance: Satellite Monitoring for Industrial Land Regulations
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a runner-up winner (github:1155558847) in industrial monitoring and environmental compliance, combining remote sensing data with actionable visualization.

ideas.pitch: A platform that indexes unstructured corporate and educational video recordings, transforming them into fully searchable, time-stamped text transcripts using local Whisper and vision models.
ideas.title: VideoLibrarian: Multimodal Video Intelligence and Semantic Search Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows a first-prize and people's choice winner (github:1200926140) focused on transforming unstructured media into accessible data, guaranteeing high engagement during live demo presentations.
